name: Gliff
author: nixfred
description: One-click gliff remote desktop from the bar. Lists the machines gliff already knows plus the online Linux nodes on your tailnet; click one to open its Hyprland desktop in a window.

barWidget.description: Click a machine to open its desktop with gliff.

schema.label: ssh user for tailnet machines
schema.description: Used to build user@host for machines found on your tailnet. Empty means your own login name.

schema.label: Default screen mode
schema.description: mirror shows the remote's focused screen. private creates a screen sized to the gliff window.

schema.label: List online tailnet machines
schema.description: Adds the online Linux nodes from tailscale status. Machines gliff has connected to before are always listed.
